# Moss & Mail

> Moss & Mail is a monthly handwritten letter subscription for women who want a slower, more intentional life. Each letter is written by hand, outdoors in the mountains of Utah, and sealed with wax. $11 a month. Ships worldwide.

Founded in 2026 by Kayli Angeleaux in Utah, United States.

## What arrives each month

One wax-sealed envelope containing:

- **A handwritten letter** composed outdoors in the Utah mountains, printed on beautiful paper and signed by hand. Honest and personal — the beauty Kayli is finding, what she is struggling with, what she is mulling over. A letter from a friend.
- **A curated Spotify playlist** to listen to while you open it, reached by QR code.
- **A Letter to the Editor Q&A** answering a question sent in by a subscriber.
- **A nature-inspired journaling prompt** and conversation starter.
- **A simple, nourishing recipe.**
- **A photograph from the mountains or an original watercolour** painted by Kayli's children. One of a kind.
- **A seasonal surprise**, chosen for the month and the mood. Past envelopes have carried tea, a bookmark, or seeds. Some things come back. Some things come only once.

## Pricing

- Monthly, United States: $11.00 USD per month
- Monthly, International: $12.70 USD per month, postage included. Ships to over 80 countries.
- Gift, 6 months: $60.00 USD one time
- Gift, 12 months: $120.00 USD one time

## Who it is for

Women who want a slower, more intentional life. Mothers of young children. Homeschooling families, particularly those following Charlotte Mason. Grandmothers. Highly sensitive women. Anyone who misses finding something real in the mailbox.

## About Kayli Angeleaux

Kayli Angeleaux founded Moss & Mail in 2026. She writes every letter by hand, outdoors, in the mountains near her home in Utah. Before Moss & Mail she restored a 218-year-old home in Ohio, which she documented on YouTube.
